Q-023-p1-BSR-MW-02-1.source_note: The Confession of Faith of the Evangelical United Brethren Church, Article I, names God as 'the one true, holy and living God, Eternal Spirit,' affirming spiritual being as a divine attribute.
Q-023-p1-BSR-MW-02-1.scope_caveat: The Articles of Religion and the EUB Confession are constitutionally protected standards of the United Methodist Church. The Global Methodist Church, which separated in 2022, holds the same Articles; its standards are cited here from its 2022 Transitional Book of Doctrines and Discipline, the only edition published on the church's own domain, and the Articles are unchanged in the 2024 edition. The Wesleyan Church holds its own articles, which the registry lists separately.
